name: Akamind Inc
notes:
Akamind (AS396144) is an IPv6-only network for content delivery and email infrastructure.

Products: Rivva (content edge) and Oveyon (email delivery platform).
Sites: Ashburn VA, Dallas TX, Portland OR.

Routing hygiene:
- RPKI: every announced prefix has an exact ROA (maxLength = prefix length, RFC 9319)
- IRR: ARIN::AS-AKAMIND, with a route6 object per announced prefix
- Geofeed (RFC 8805): https://akamind.net/geofeed.csv

Open peering policy - IXP or PNI, anywhere we are present. peering@akamind.net
